WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS average_remaining
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY event_status
), baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_remaining) AS average_of_status_averages
    FROM status_averages
)
SELECT sa.event_status, sa.average_remaining,
       sa.average_remaining - b.average_of_status_averages AS difference_from_baseline
FROM status_averages AS sa
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE b.average_of_status_averages IS NOT NULL;
